breaking_news.headline: China signals possible return of U.S. trade privileges for Hong Kong
breaking_news.summary: The decision comes two months after President Donald Trump met with Xi Jinping, potentially warming ties ahead of Xi's expected U.S. visit.

breaking_news.headline: The 2000s called. They want their digital camera back
breaking_news.summary: Why are people who weren't born 25 years ago snapping up the digital camera of that era? Blame Taylor Swift, trend cycles, childhood nostalgia and smartphone fatigue.

breaking_news.headline: Court ruling freezes Paramount-Warner Bros. merger for now
breaking_news.summary: Paramount's owners were hoping they'd be firmly in control of rival Warner Bros. Discovery by the end of this week. Monday's temporary restraining order puts that plan on hold.

breaking_news.headline: Amid nurse shortage, a university rolls out the welcome mat for men
breaking_news.summary: Only about 1 in 8 nurses are men, but their share is growing. A strong job market for nurses and sustained efforts to recruit men into the field have made a difference, including in the South.

breaking_news.headline: The best economic ideas from around the world — Planet Money Summer School is back
breaking_news.summary: Our free economics course for your ears is on a quest for great economics ideas.

breaking_news.headline: Trump imposes 50% tariffs on Canadian goods
breaking_news.summary: President Donald Trump on Monday imposed 50% tariffs on most Canadian goods, declaring that Canada has unfairly discriminated against American autos, alcohol and dairy products.

breaking_news.headline: Staying in a job for the health insurance? About 1 in 4 Americans do, a survey says
breaking_news.summary: About 24% of U.S. employees stay in unwanted jobs just for health insurance, a report out Wednesday finds. Up significantly since 2021, the uptick in "job lock" is a concerning sign for the U.S. economy.

breaking_news.headline: In South Dakota, public media endures a year after federal funding was wiped out
breaking_news.summary: We check in on one state public broadcasting network a year after President Trump signed a law ending federal funding of public media.

breaking_news.headline: Two Russians handed down jail terms for terrorism and spying in Angola
breaking_news.summary: The two, a political consultant and a translator, denied allegations of fomenting protests last year.

breaking_news.headline: Mamdani backs off pledge to arrest Netanyahu citing lack of authority
breaking_news.summary: The New York City mayor instead called on US authorities to act on International Criminal Court's arrest warrant against the Israeli prime minister.

breaking_news.headline: Wreckage of Pan Am plane that shaped aviation safety found 74 years on
breaking_news.summary: The deaths of 52 people on the Clipper Endeavor led to the introduction of mandatory pre-flight safety briefings.

breaking_news.headline: British woman jailed for blackmail after accusing banker of rape in Hong Kong
breaking_news.summary: Isabel Rose was convicted of trying to extort £100,000 from the UK banker and perverting the course of justice.

breaking_news.headline: Fire kills 10 members of same family in Peru, police say
breaking_news.summary:
Authorities are investigating the cause of the blaze in Lima as local media report
 it may have been arson.

breaking_news.headline: Tankers make sharp U-turns after Houthi shipping threat
breaking_news.summary: All of the ships were travelling to or from Saudi ports before changing course, ship-tracking data shows.

breaking_news.headline: Trump threatens to target Iran's bridges and power plants if Hormuz attacks persist
breaking_news.summary: Donald Trump says the US will respond any time Iranian forces shoot at a ship in the Strait of Hormuz.

breaking_news.headline: US signs landmark nuclear deal with Saudi Arabia
breaking_news.summary: The US Department of Energy says the "peaceful" co-operation agreement will give US firms "great access" to the Saudi nuclear energy programme.

breaking_news.headline: The borough where families are slowly disappearing
breaking_news.summary: Islington is a snapshot of a trend playing out across inner London, Britain and much of the world.

breaking_news.headline: Most bus fares in England to be capped at £2 from January
breaking_news.summary: The government says the policy will "help with the cost of living and give people the breathing space they need"

breaking_news.headline: OpenAI says its AI went rogue and launched 'unprecedented' cyber-attack
breaking_news.summary: It is one of the first publicly disclosed cyber-attacks carried out by AI without direct human involvement.

breaking_news.headline: Aston Martin secures £550m loan deal
breaking_news.summary: The luxury car maker says the loans will be used to fund current and future product plans.
